name: agent-bus-dashboard
description: Operate the existing local agent coordinator and AgentBus from Codex and a unified localhost dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Projects, usage, live sessions, agent controls, and conversations.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the existing Agent Coordinator and AgentBus services, and adds a dependency-free localhost dashboard for choosing a project, monitoring current-session usage, opening resumable agent sessions in Terminal, controlling attached supervisors, and managing complete conversation history with Inbox, Archive, and Trash.
defaultPrompt: Show agents in the selected project.
Show current AgentBus usage by subscription.
Open the complete AgentBus conversation history.
